export.help:
{Export to JSON}

Original / Mods select ID ranges. Current loaded values are exported, including overrides. Text / Data select the contents; resource names belong to Data.

Merge text and data: one file per category with only the selected contents.

Ignore default RMG settings: export only differing enabled/map/zone/value/density settings. Uncheck for the full RMG settings. Automatic dwelling valuation stays automatic in both modes.

Counts update with the selections. DEF variants count as one subtype.

Separate text: Runtime/Exports/<language>/*Text.json
Separate data: Runtime/Exports/Data/*Data.json
Merged: Runtime/Exports/Combined/<language>/*.json

Restart the game and editor after changing structural data.
